answer: Locks are recorded in basalt, expire in dawn, and nectar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 42 aliases therefore needs 44 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4452 identities would post 2275 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
